methods.inverse_fold: one-at-a-time masked structure-conditioned pseudolikelihood at ten mutated positions
methods.folding: ESMFold2-Fast, three loops and 50 sampling steps
methods.potts: rank-32 low-rank Potts, L2 selected lambda=1.0, n_eff=1336.07
methods.color_rule: green=favorable parent-relative direction; red=unfavorable; amber=mixed/watch; arbitrary Potts/log scores use deltas rather than misleading percentages
methods.af2: local ColabFold 1.6.2 AlphaFold2-pTM model 1; existing target MSA; 3 recycles, 1 ensemble, seed 0, no templates, no relaxation

summary.af2_validation_definition: candidate versus AF2 parent: pLDDT >= parent-0.010, pTM >= parent-0.020, max-domain RMSD <= 1.50 Å, essential-site RMSD <= 0.75 Å, active pocket RMSD <= 0.75 Å
